title: Text: DET Nick Castellanos ↔ Anthony Fenech

content.text: https://twitter.com/SimplyAJ10/status/1260579351365652481?s=20
I think he’s got a point. You
You guys are the reason there is a MLB. You’re a smart dude with conviction on things. Right now, all I see are the national reporters parroting MLB’s negotiating points
You know why? Because that’s where they get their paychecks (MLB Network) and scoops (MLB offices, when transactions go through) ... so now they are massaging those sources in the commish’s office
I can’t open that I don’t have Twitter

It’s just an Adam Jones tweet saying “It’s time for the BIG GUYS in MLB to speak up. This is your time to speak. Stop holding your tongue. Ppl follow and listen to you. Not gonna name names cause there’s a lot of ppl. Who cars what you make. You earned it. Who cars about backlash!! TIME TO SPEAK THE F UP!”
And he’s talking about what exactly?
I think speaking out against the owners and MLB and what they’re trying to do
What is it exactly they are trying to do?
Get you guys to take less money and it feels like they’re trying to paint you guys as the bad guys in this whole thing
100% because our salaries are public and the amount they make is private
That’s why I told Scott my next contract is confidential to media
Emphasized “That’s why I told Scott my next contract is confidential to media ”
I dunno, I see you as being one of those guys, like a leader kinda guy and I haven’t seen much from players on it

Could be an opportunity there to take a stand kinda thing. (And I’m not saying talk to me, I’m just saying I’ve seen how you’ve learned to speak your mind on certain things and I def. think there’s a platform for players to speak their mind right now)
I agree with that. Let me pay attention to how these events are unfolding
For sure. Maybe talk to Scott about it... hope you’re doing well
I also hope that Central division plan works and you get to play the Tigers 10 times
Later dude
Be safe be well
